definitions.explanation: The hollow beneath the shoulder where the arm joins the body. A medical and anatomical term; the everyday word is {脇|わき} or {脇|わき}の{下|した}.

examples.japanese: {腋窩|えきか}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{体温|たいおん}→体温：03385_taion⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{測|はか}る→測る：01977_hakaru⟧。
examples.english: I take the temperature at the armpit.

examples.japanese: {腋窩|えきか}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{リンパ節|りんぱせつ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧。
examples.english: There are many lymph nodes in the armpit.

examples.japanese: ⟦{診察|しんさつ}→診察：03259_shinsatsu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{医師|いし}→医師：11851_ishi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{腋窩|えきか}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{腫|は}れ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{確認|かくにん}した→確認する：25332_kakuninsuru⟧。
examples.english: During the examination, the doctor checked for swelling in the armpit.

notes:
A medical and anatomical term for the armpit. In everyday speech, ⟦{脇|わき}の{下|した}→脇の下：19060_wakinoshita⟧ is used instead.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {腋窩|えきか}{温|おん}: axillary temperature
- {腋窩|えきか}{リンパ節|りんぱせつ}: axillary lymph nodes

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{脇|わき}の{下|した}→脇の下：19060_wakinoshita⟧: armpit — the ordinary, everyday expression.
- ⟦{脇|わき}→脇：03790_waki⟧: side (of the body); armpit area — broader everyday word.
